headline: The judgments go to plain code that picks the next question and which box to name.

media.alt: Video from the post by k0n00

text: My voice interviewer can't see the whiteboard; GPT-Live takes no images. The box I named "Fastly" is read as a CDN at 1.00, and my note "sync or async transcode?" as a question I still owe. Jev answers dozen of questions like that in under half a second. The voice never hears…
